_doc: The DexNav's area snapshots (b2tools/dexnav_snapshots.py, notes/DEXNAV.md): crops = a map's panel window: [x, y], its top-left metatile in the map (it may reach past the map's edges, into its border blocks: Route 115's sea column), or two bands [[x, y, rows], [x, y, rows]] (9 rows in all) shown as two views with a frame bar between them, for a map whose groups live too far apart for one window (Route 111: the desert's rocks above, the pond by Mauville below; no window of Route 111 holds both its deep sand and its water). stand_ins = groups whose map has no tile of their kind at all (their icons stand on walkable tiles): Mirage Island's land on Route 130, Shoal Cave's high-tide water in its low-tide rooms. Version overlays (data/emerald/dexnav_snapshots.json) add or replace entries.
